"""Independent snapshot divergence audit; writes only to solver/diagnostics.

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
folder = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
z = np.load(sorted(folder.glob("snapshot_*.npy"))[-1]).astype(float)
r = np.load(folder/"r_au.npy").astype(float)
theta = np.load(folder/"theta_rad.npy").astype(float)
phi = np.load(folder/"phi_rad.npy").astype(float)
nr, nt, nphi = z.shape[:3]
cfg = {}
for line in (folder/"run.cfg").read_text().splitlines():
    if "=" in line:
        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        cfg[k.strip()] = v.strip()
rmin, rmax = float(cfg["rmin_au"]), float(cfg["rmax_au"])
rf = np.geomspace(rmin, rmax, nr+1) if cfg.get("radial_grid") == "log" else np.linspace(rmin, rmax, nr+1)
latmax = np.radians(float(cfg["latmax_deg"]))
tf = np.linspace(np.pi/2-latmax, np.pi/2+latmax, nt+1)
dp = 2*np.pi/nphi
st, ct = np.sin(theta)[None, :, None], np.cos(theta)[None, :, None]
sp, cp = np.sin(phi)[None, None, :], np.cos(phi)[None, None, :]
er = np.stack(np.broadcast_arrays(st*cp, st*sp, ct), axis=-1)
et = np.stack(np.broadcast_arrays(ct*cp, ct*sp, -st), axis=-1)
ep = np.stack(np.broadcast_arrays(-sp+0*st, cp+0*st, 0*st+0*sp), axis=-1)
B = z[..., 5, None]*er+z[..., 6, None]*et+z[..., 7, None]*ep
volume = ((rf[1:]**3-rf[:-1]**3)/3)[:, None, None]*(np.cos(tf[:-1])-np.cos(tf[1:]))[None, :, None]*dp
volume = np.broadcast_to(volume, z.shape[:3])
h = np.cbrt(volume)
bmag = np.linalg.norm(B, axis=-1)

# Independent spherical-derivative diagnostic. A radial B proportional to
# r^-2 has exactly zero radial contribution before round-off.
div_spherical = np.gradient(r[:, None, None]**2*z[..., 5], r, axis=0, edge_order=2)/r[:, None, None]**2
div_spherical += np.gradient(st*z[..., 6], theta, axis=1, edge_order=2)/(r[:, None, None]*st)
div_spherical += (np.roll(z[..., 7], -1, 2)-np.roll(z[..., 7], 1, 2))/(2*dp*r[:, None, None]*st)

# Cartesian integrated-face diagnostic, matching the solver in interior cells.
ar = .5*np.diff(tf)-.25*np.diff(np.sin(2*tf))
az = .5*np.diff(np.sin(tf)**2)
radial_area = np.stack(np.broadcast_arrays(
    rf[:, None, None]**2*ar[None, :, None]*2*np.sin(dp/2)*cp,
    rf[:, None, None]**2*ar[None, :, None]*2*np.sin(dp/2)*sp,
    rf[:, None, None]**2*az[None, :, None]*dp+0*cp), axis=-1)

theta_area = np.stack(np.broadcast_arrays(
    w*np.cos(tf)[None, :, None]*2*np.sin(dp/2)*cp,
    w*np.cos(tf)[None, :, None]*2*np.sin(dp/2)*sp,
    -w*np.sin(tf)[None, :, None]*dp+0*cp), axis=-1)

wp = .5*np.diff(rf**2)[:, None, None]*np.diff(tf)[None, :, None]

f_r = np.sum(.5*(B[:-1]+B[1:])*radial_area[1:-1], axis=-1)
f_t = np.sum(.5*(B[:, :-1]+B[:, 1:])*theta_area[:, 1:-1], axis=-1)

div_fv = np.full_like(bmag, np.nan)

                                  +np.roll(f_p[1:-1, 1:-1], -1, axis=2)-f_p[1:-1, 1:-1])/volume[1:-1, 1:-1]

probes = np.genfromtxt(folder/"probe.csv", delimiter=",", names=True)
comet = probes[probes["probe_id"] == 0][-1]
ri = int(np.argmin(abs(r-comet["r_au"])))
tj = int(np.argmin(abs(theta-(np.pi/2-comet["lat_rad"]))))
pk = int(np.argmin(abs(np.angle(np.exp(1j*(phi-comet["lon_rad"]))))))
regions = {}
interior = np.zeros_like(bmag, dtype=bool)
interior[1:-1, 1:-1] = True
regions["all_interior"] = interior
regions["r_gt_0p3_lat_lt_15deg"] = interior & (r[:, None, None] > .3) & (abs(np.pi/2-theta)[None, :, None] < np.radians(15))
regions["r_1p5_2p1_lat_lt_15deg"] = regions["r_gt_0p3_lat_lt_15deg"] & (r[:, None, None] > 1.5) & (r[:, None, None] < 2.1)
near = np.zeros_like(interior)
near[max(1,ri-1):min(nr-1,ri+2), max(1,tj-1):min(nt-1,tj+2)] = False
for kk in [(pk-1)%nphi, pk, (pk+1)%nphi]:
    near[max(1,ri-1):min(nr-1,ri+2), max(1,tj-1):min(nt-1,tj+2), kk] = True
regions["comet_neighborhood_3cubed"] = near
speed = np.linalg.norm(z[..., 1:4], axis=-1)*1000
rho = z[..., 0]*1e6*1.67262192369e-27
output = {"snapshot_day": float(comet["day"]), "comet_nearest_index": [ri, tj, pk], "methods": {}}

    force_ratio = bmag*abs(div)*1e-18*r[:, None, None]/(1.25663706212e-6*rho*speed**2)

                            weighted_hdivB_over_B=float(np.sum(h[mask]*abs(div[mask])*volume[mask])/np.sum(bmag[mask]*volume[mask])),
                            median_hdivB_over_B=float(np.median(eps[mask])),

                            percentile95_monopole_force_over_inertia=float(np.percentile(force_ratio[mask], 95)))

                                         monopole_force_over_inertia=float(force_ratio[ri,tj,pk]),
                                         divB_nT_AU=float(div[ri,tj,pk]),
                                         Bmag_nT=float(bmag[ri,tj,pk]),
                                         density_cm3=float(z[ri,tj,pk,0]))
    output["methods"][method] = metrics
dest = HERE/"diagnostics"
dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(dest/f"{folder.name}_divergence.json").write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))

+def sha(path):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with open(path, "rb") as f:
+        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(8 << 20), b""):
+            h.update(b)
+    return {"path": str(Path(path).resolve()), "bytes": Path(path).stat().st_size,
+            "sha256": h.hexdigest()}

+def geometry(probe_path, probe_id, day):
+    p = np.genfromtxt(probe_path, delimiter=",", names=True, ndmin=1)
+    for field in ("day", "probe_id", "r_au", "lon_rad", "lat_rad"):
+        if field not in p.dtype.names:
+            raise ValueError(f"Missing probe field {field}")
+    p = p[p["probe_id"] == probe_id]
+    p = p[np.argsort(p["day"])]
+    if len(p) < 2 or np.any(np.diff(p["day"]) <= 0):
+        raise ValueError("Comet geometry requires at least two strictly ordered epochs")
+    t = p["day"]
+    # Tolerance covers decimal manifest/probe serialization, never a cadence gap.
+    tolerance = 5e-10
+    if day < t[0]-tolerance or day > t[-1]+tolerance:
+        raise ValueError(f"Snapshot day {day:.17g} outside probe coverage "
+                         f"[{t[0]:.17g}, {t[-1]:.17g}]; extrapolation is forbidden")
+    q = float(np.clip(day, t[0], t[-1]))
+    k = int(np.clip(np.searchsorted(t, q, side="right")-1, 0, len(t)-2))
+    a = float((q-t[k])/(t[k+1]-t[k]))
+    longitude = np.unwrap(p["lon_rad"])
+    values = {name: float((1-a)*p[name][k]+a*p[name][k+1])
+              for name in ("r_au", "lat_rad")}
+    values["lon_rad"] = float(((1-a)*longitude[k]+a*longitude[k+1]) % (2*np.pi))
+    values.update(probe_id=probe_id, actual_snapshot_day=day,
+                  bracketing_probe_days=[float(t[k]), float(t[k+1])],
+                  interpolation_fraction=a,
+                  probe_coverage_days=[float(t[0]), float(t[-1])],
+                  median_probe_interval_minutes=float(np.median(np.diff(t))*1440),
+                  interpolation="linear r and latitude; linearly interpolated unwrapped longitude")
+    return values

+def derivative_coefficients(x):
+    a, b, c = x[:-2], x[1:-1], x[2:]
+    return ((b-c)/((a-b)*(a-c)),
+            (2*b-a-c)/((b-a)*(b-c)),
+            (b-a)/((c-a)*(c-b)))

+def chunks(path, block=1 << 18):
+    with open(path, "rb") as f:
+        while True:
+            x = np.fromfile(f, dtype="<f8", count=block)
+            if not len(x):
+                return
+            yield x

+def exact_percentiles(path, n, low, high, memory_bytes=32 << 20):
+    """Exact linear-interpolated order statistics, with bounded scan/refinement.
+
+    Histogram bins locate order statistics; final samples are selected exactly.
+    No histogram approximation enters the reported median or percentile95.
+    """
+    if not n:
+        return {"median": None, "percentile95": None, "minimum": None, "maximum": None}
+    positions = [q*(n-1) for q in (.5, .95)]
+    ranks = sorted({int(math.floor(x)) for x in positions} |
+                   {int(math.ceil(x)) for x in positions})
+    selected = {}
+
+    def find(lo, hi, closed, count, wanted, depth=0):
+        if lo == hi:
+            selected.update({k: float(lo) for k in wanted})
+            return
+        if depth > 64:
+            raise RuntimeError("Exact percentile rank refinement failed")
+        if count*8 <= memory_bytes:
+            samples = np.empty(count, dtype=float)
+            cursor = 0
+            for x in chunks(path):
+                v = x[(x >= lo) & ((x <= hi) if closed else (x < hi))]
+                samples[cursor:cursor+len(v)] = v
+                cursor += len(v)
+            if cursor != count:
+                raise RuntimeError("Rank selection count mismatch")
+            samples.partition(wanted)
+            selected.update({k_global: float(samples[k_local])
+                             for k_local, k_global in wanted.items()})
+            return
+        edges = np.unique(np.linspace(lo, hi, 2049))
+        if len(edges) == 2:
+            # Adjacent floating-point values: distinguish the endpoints exactly.
+            nlo = sum(int(np.count_nonzero(x == lo)) for x in chunks(path))
+            for k, global_k in wanted.items():
+                selected[global_k] = float(lo if k < nlo else hi)
+            return
+        hist = np.zeros(len(edges)-1, dtype=np.int64)
+        for x in chunks(path):
+            x = x[(x >= lo) & ((x <= hi) if closed else (x < hi))]
+            hist += np.histogram(x, bins=edges)[0]
+        if int(hist.sum()) != count:
+            raise RuntimeError("Rank histogram count mismatch")
+        cumulative = np.cumsum(hist)
+        groups = {}
+        for k, global_k in wanted.items():
+            j = int(np.searchsorted(cumulative, k, side="right"))
+            before = int(cumulative[j-1]) if j else 0
+            groups.setdefault(j, {})[k-before] = global_k
+        for j, subset in groups.items():
+            find(float(edges[j]), float(edges[j+1]),
+                 closed and j == len(hist)-1, int(hist[j]), subset, depth+1)
+
+    find(low, high, True, n, {k: k for k in ranks})
+    answers = []
+    for x in positions:
+        a, b = int(math.floor(x)), int(math.ceil(x))
+        answers.append((1-(x-a))*selected[a]+(x-a)*selected[b])
+    return dict(median=float(answers[0]), percentile95=float(answers[1]),
+                minimum=float(low), maximum=float(high))
+

+class Accumulator:
+    def __init__(self, directory, name):
+        self.files = {k: open(directory/f"{name}_{k}.f64", "wb") for k in ("epsilon", "force")}
+        self.n = self.bad_div = self.nulls = self.bad_inertia = 0
+        self.volume = self.null_volume = self.numerator = self.denominator = 0.
+        self.bounds = {k: [math.inf, -math.inf, 0] for k in self.files}
+
+    def add(self, mask, div, bmag, h, volume, force_denominator, radius, null_threshold):
+        self.n += int(np.count_nonzero(mask))
+        valid = mask & np.isfinite(div) & np.isfinite(bmag)
+        self.bad_div += int(np.count_nonzero(mask & ~valid))
+        vol = np.broadcast_to(volume, div.shape)
+        self.volume += float(np.sum(vol[valid]))
+        self.numerator += float(np.sum((h*np.abs(div)*vol)[valid]))
+        self.denominator += float(np.sum((bmag*vol)[valid]))
+        null = valid & (bmag <= null_threshold)
+        self.nulls += int(np.count_nonzero(null))
+        self.null_volume += float(np.sum(vol[null]))
+        eps_valid = valid & ~null
+        epsilon = (h*np.abs(div))[eps_valid]/bmag[eps_valid]
+        fvalid = valid & np.isfinite(force_denominator) & (force_denominator > 0)
+        self.bad_inertia += int(np.count_nonzero(valid & ~fvalid))
+        force = (bmag*np.abs(div)*1e-18*radius)[fvalid]/force_denominator[fvalid]
+        for key, values in (("epsilon", epsilon), ("force", force)):
+            values = values[np.isfinite(values)]
+            values.astype("<f8", copy=False).tofile(self.files[key])
+            if len(values):
+                bounds = self.bounds[key]
+                bounds[0] = min(bounds[0], float(values.min()))
+                bounds[1] = max(bounds[1], float(values.max()))
+                bounds[2] += len(values)
+
+    def finish(self):
+        output = dict(cells=self.n, nonfinite_div_or_B_cells=self.bad_div,
+                      volume_AU3=self.volume, null_or_threshold_B_cells=self.nulls,
+                      null_or_threshold_B_volume_fraction=(self.null_volume/self.volume if self.volume else None),
+                      invalid_inertia_cells=self.bad_inertia,
+                      weighted_hdivB_over_B=(self.numerator/self.denominator if self.denominator else None))
+        for key, f in self.files.items():
+            f.close()
+            lo, hi, n = self.bounds[key]
+            output[key+"_valid_cells"] = n
+            for statistic, value in exact_percentiles(f.name, n, lo, hi).items():
+                suffix = "hdivB_over_B" if key == "epsilon" else "monopole_force_over_inertia"
+                output[statistic+"_"+suffix] = value
+        return output

+def audit_snapshot(path, epoch, comet, cfg, axes, args, temporary):
+    stored_r, stored_t, stored_p = axes
+    nr, nt, np_ = len(stored_r), len(stored_t), len(stored_p)
+    rf = (np.geomspace if cfg.get("radial_grid") == "log" else np.linspace)(
+        float(cfg["rmin_au"]), float(cfg["rmax_au"]), nr+1)
+    latmax = np.deg2rad(float(cfg["latmax_deg"]))
+    tf = np.linspace(np.pi/2-latmax, np.pi/2+latmax, nt+1)
+    dp = 2*np.pi/np_
+    exact_axes = ((rf[:-1]+rf[1:])/2, (tf[:-1]+tf[1:])/2,
+                  (np.arange(np_)+.5)*dp)
+    # Solver rc uses arithmetic face midpoints even on logarithmic radial grids.
+    for name, stored, exact in zip(("r", "theta", "phi"), axes, exact_axes):
+        if not np.allclose(stored, exact, rtol=2e-7, atol=2e-7):
+            raise ValueError(f"Stored {name} centers do not agree with exact run.cfg geometry")
+    r, theta, phi = exact_axes if args.center_coordinates == "exact-config" else axes
+    if min(nr, nt, np_) < 3:
+        raise ValueError("At least three centers per coordinate are required")
+    z = np.load(path, mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
+    if z.shape != (nr, nt, np_, 8) or z.dtype.kind != "f":
+        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected volume shape or dtype: {z.shape}, {z.dtype}")
+    if z.flags.f_contiguous:
+        raise ValueError("Only C-ordered snapshot serialization is supported")
+    ri = int(np.argmin(abs(r-comet["r_au"])))
+    tj = int(np.argmin(abs(theta-(np.pi/2-comet["lat_rad"]))))
+    pk = int(np.argmin(abs(np.angle(np.exp(1j*(phi-comet["lon_rad"]))))))
+    near_r = np.arange(max(1, ri-1), min(nr-1, ri+2))
+    near_t = np.arange(max(1, tj-1), min(nt-1, tj+2))
+    near_p = np.unique([(pk-1)%np_, pk, (pk+1)%np_])
+    region_names = ("all_interior", "r_gt_0p3_lat_lt_15deg",
+                    "r_1p5_2p1_lat_lt_15deg", "comet_neighborhood_3cubed")
+    acc = {method: {name: Accumulator(temporary, method+"_"+name) for name in region_names}
+           for method in METHODS}
+    nearest = {}
+    # Conservative array-count estimate: <=80 float64 planes plus input halo.
+    plane_bytes = nt*np_*8
+    slab = min(args.slab_radial, nr-2, max(1, int((args.memory_mib*2**20-64*2**20)/(96*plane_bytes))-2))
+    estimate = (96*(slab+2)*plane_bytes+64*2**20)
+    if estimate > args.memory_mib*2**20:
+        raise ValueError("A single radial slab exceeds the declared working memory budget")
+    st, ct = np.sin(theta)[None, :, None], np.cos(theta)[None, :, None]
+    sp, cp = np.sin(phi)[None, None, :], np.cos(phi)[None, None, :]
+    ar = .5*np.diff(tf)-.25*np.diff(np.sin(2*tf))
+    az = .5*np.diff(np.sin(tf)**2)
+    cp_edge, sp_edge = np.cos(np.arange(np_)*dp), np.sin(np.arange(np_)*dp)
+    vtheta = (np.cos(tf[:-1])-np.cos(tf[1:]))[None, 1:-1, None]*dp
+    cr = derivative_coefficients(r)
+    ctheta = tuple(x[None, :, None] for x in derivative_coefficients(theta))
+    for begin in range(1, nr-1, slab):
+        end = min(nr-1, begin+slab)
+        d = np.array(z[begin-1:end+1], dtype=np.float64)
+        br, bt, bp = d[..., 5], d[..., 6], d[..., 7]
+        bx = br*st*cp+bt*ct*cp-bp*sp
+        by = br*st*sp+bt*ct*sp+bp*cp
+        bz = br*ct-bt*st
+        cart = (bx, by, bz)
+        # Fluxes at radial interfaces separating adjacent cell centers.
+        radial_area = (ar[None, :, None]*2*np.sin(dp/2)*cp,
+                       ar[None, :, None]*2*np.sin(dp/2)*sp,
+                       az[None, :, None]*dp)
+        fr = sum(.5*(b[:-1]+b[1:])*a for b, a in zip(cart, radial_area))
+        fr *= rf[begin:end+1, None, None]**2
+        w = .5*np.diff(rf**2)[begin:end, None, None]*np.sin(tf)[None, 1:-1, None]
+        theta_area = (w*np.cos(tf)[None, 1:-1, None]*2*np.sin(dp/2)*cp,
+                      w*np.cos(tf)[None, 1:-1, None]*2*np.sin(dp/2)*sp,
+                      -w*np.sin(tf)[None, 1:-1, None]*dp)
+        ft = sum(.5*(b[1:-1, :-1]+b[1:-1, 1:])*a for b, a in zip(cart, theta_area))
+        wp = .5*np.diff(rf**2)[begin:end, None, None]*np.diff(tf)[None, 1:-1, None]
+        fp = wp*(-.5*(bx[1:-1, 1:-1]+np.roll(bx[1:-1, 1:-1], 1, 2))*sp_edge
+                 +.5*(by[1:-1, 1:-1]+np.roll(by[1:-1, 1:-1], 1, 2))*cp_edge)
+        volume = np.diff(rf**3)[begin:end, None, None]/3*vtheta
+        h = np.cbrt(volume)
+        div_fv = (fr[1:, 1:-1]-fr[:-1, 1:-1]+ft[:, 1:]-ft[:, :-1]
+                  +np.roll(fp, -1, axis=2)-fp)/volume
+        rr = r[begin:end, None, None]
+        radial_term = sum(c[begin-1:end-1, None, None]*r[s, None, None]**2*br[q, 1:-1]
+                          for c, s, q in zip(cr,
+                              (slice(begin-1, end-1), slice(begin, end), slice(begin+1, end+1)),
+                              (slice(None, -2), slice(1, -1), slice(2, None))))/rr**2
+        theta_term = sum(c*(st*bt)[1:-1, q] for c, q in zip(ctheta,
+                         (slice(None, -2), slice(1, -1), slice(2, None))))/(rr*st[:, 1:-1])
+        phi_term = (np.roll(bp[1:-1, 1:-1], -1, 2)-np.roll(bp[1:-1, 1:-1], 1, 2))/(2*dp*rr*st[:, 1:-1])
+        div_sphere = radial_term+theta_term+phi_term
+        bmag = np.sqrt(br[1:-1, 1:-1]**2+bt[1:-1, 1:-1]**2+bp[1:-1, 1:-1]**2)
+        rho = d[1:-1, 1:-1, :, 0]*1e6*MP
+        speed2 = np.sum(d[1:-1, 1:-1, :, 1:4]**2, axis=-1)*1e6
+        denominator = MU0*rho*speed2
+        ii, jj, kk = np.arange(begin, end)[:, None, None], np.arange(1, nt-1)[None, :, None], np.arange(np_)[None, None, :]
+        equatorial = abs(np.pi/2-theta)[None, 1:-1, None] < np.deg2rad(15)
+        masks = dict(all_interior=np.ones(div_fv.shape, dtype=bool),
+                     r_gt_0p3_lat_lt_15deg=np.broadcast_to((rr > .3) & equatorial, div_fv.shape),
+                     r_1p5_2p1_lat_lt_15deg=np.broadcast_to((rr > 1.5) & (rr < 2.1) & equatorial, div_fv.shape),
+                     comet_neighborhood_3cubed=np.isin(ii, near_r) & np.isin(jj, near_t) & np.isin(kk, near_p))
+        for method, divergence in zip(METHODS, (div_fv, div_sphere)):
+            for name, mask in masks.items():
+                acc[method][name].add(mask, divergence, bmag, h, volume, denominator, rr, args.B_null_nT)
+            if begin <= ri < end and 1 <= tj < nt-1:
+                idx = (ri-begin, tj-1, pk)
+                db, bm = float(divergence[idx]), float(bmag[idx])
+                den = float(denominator[idx])
+                nearest[method] = dict(divB_nT_AU=db, Bmag_nT=bm,
+                    hdivB_over_B=float(h[ri-begin, tj-1, 0]*abs(db)/bm) if bm > args.B_null_nT else None,
+                    monopole_force_over_inertia=bm*abs(db)*1e-18*r[ri]/den if den > 0 else None,
+                    density_cm3=float(d[ri-begin+1, tj, pk, 0]),
+                    speed_kms=float(np.sqrt(speed2[idx])/1000),
+                    h_AU=float(h[ri-begin, tj-1, 0]))
+        # Release transient arrays and advise the kernel to evict mapped input pages.
+        del d, br, bt, bp, bx, by, bz, cart, fr, ft, fp, radial_area, theta_area
+        del div_fv, div_sphere, divergence, radial_term, theta_term, phi_term, bmag, rho, speed2, denominator, masks, mask
+        gc.collect()
+        if hasattr(z._mmap, "madvise"):
+            z._mmap.madvise(mmap.MADV_DONTNEED)
+        rss_mib = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024
+        if rss_mib > args.memory_mib:
+            raise MemoryError(f"Peak RSS {rss_mib:.1f} MiB exceeded --memory-mib {args.memory_mib}")
+    methods = {}
+    for method in METHODS:
+        methods[method] = {name: a.finish() for name, a in acc[method].items()}
+        methods[method]["nearest_comet_cell"] = nearest.get(method, {"unavailable": "Nearest cell is outside the audited interior"})
+    del z
+    return dict(actual_snapshot_day=epoch, shape=[nr, nt, np_, 8],
+                center_coordinates=args.center_coordinates,
+                maximum_stored_vs_config_axis_difference=dict(zip(("r_au", "theta_rad", "phi_rad"),
+                    (float(np.max(abs(x-y))) for x, y in zip(axes, exact_axes)))),
+                slab_radial_cells=slab, estimated_slab_working_bytes=estimate,
+                comet=comet, comet_nearest_index=[ri, tj, pk],
+                comet_nearest_cell=dict(r_au=float(r[ri]), lat_rad=float(np.pi/2-theta[tj]), lon_rad=float(phi[pk])),
+                methods=methods)
+
